answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission. Every claim climbs the horizon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ember re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
